decks.notes: This Modern UR Aggro deck focuses on efficiently disrupting opponents while aggressively playing threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. The key strategy is to control the game with counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell, while using removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to clear the way for your creatures. Expressive Iteration and Consider provide card advantage and help you dig for the cards you need to maintain pressure on your opponent. Overall, the deck aims to quickly apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a swift victory.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to use aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, along with removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to quickly take control of the game. Thoughtseize and Grief help disrupt the opponent's hand, while Seasoned Pyromancer provides card advantage. Feign Death and Undying Malice offer protection and recursion for your creatures. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can provide a powerful finisher. The deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain momentum throughout the game, closing out with efficient threats and removal.

The main concept of this deck is to use cards like Indomitable Creativity, Transmogrify, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty onto the battlefield. The deck combines creativity with control elements like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent. By utilizing cards like Dwarven Mine and Wrenn and Six for land recursion, the deck aims to create a powerful board state quickly and overwhelm the opponent with its combo potential.

This deck aims to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to create a loop that allows you to continuously mill your library and generate infinite mana. Once this combo is established, you can then use Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber to cast a lethal Grapeshot or use Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to steal your opponent's entire library. The deck is designed for explosive plays and aims to win the game in just a few turns.

This UrzaTron deck focuses on using the Urza lands (Mines, Power Plants, and Towers) to quickly assemble mana for powerful spells and threats. The deck includes a mix of colorless and colored spells, with a strong emphasis on control elements like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Oblivion Stone. The addition of Jegantha as a companion provides additional utility and flexibility to the deck's gameplan. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while establishing a dominating board presence with big threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Karn, the Great Creator.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through targeted removal, hand disruption, and land destruction while generating card advantage and mana advantage through cards like Relic of Progenitus, Fatal Push, and Cabal Coffers. The deck aims to control the board state and out-value the opponent until it can close out the game with cards like March of Wretched Sorrow and Invoke Despair. Karn, the Great Creator serves as a versatile threat and toolbox card to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This UR Aggro deck relies on a combination of cheap, efficient spells and aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. By utilizing cheap counterspells like Spell Pierce and Spell Snare, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat, the deck can clear the way for powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Consider to help maintain consistency and find the right cards at the right time.

This deck focuses on quickly dealing damage to the opponent through efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The aim is to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize, using cards like Lightning Bolt, Boros Charm, and Skullcrack to prevent them from gaining life or stopping your creatures. The mana base is designed to ensure a consistent flow of red mana for casting spells, with some utility lands like Sunbaked Canyon and Fiery Islet for card draw.

Utilizing creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities and control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck focuses on ramping into powerful Elementals like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines while utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler for tempo advantage. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion adds consistency to the deck by requiring only cards with converted mana cost 3 or greater, allowing for powerful card draw in the mid to late game. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient control and elemental synergy.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying cheap and efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Sprite Dragon, while supporting them with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart. The deck also utilizes the graveyard with cards like Underworld Breach and Mishra's Bauble for card advantage and recursion. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to consistently apply pressure to the opponent and win through aggressive creature attacks and direct damage.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's game plan while also deploying threats quickly to pressure them. The deck utilizes a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize, aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to control the board and deal damage efficiently. The deck also includes powerful cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Blood Moon to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's mana base. Overall, the deck aims to have a proactive game plan and quickly close out games.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the aggressive power of Merfolk creatures, supported by cards that boost their abilities and provide disruption for the opponent. The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and controlling the game through tempo plays with cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper. The inclusion of lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident also adds power to the Merfolk creatures, making them formidable threats on the battlefield. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient creature-based aggression.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty. It also utilizes cards like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Prismari Command to control the board and protect its combo pieces. Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional support and disruption. The mana base is optimized to consistently cast the combo pieces while also providing flexibility with fetch lands and dual lands. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and spells to quickly pressure the opponent's life total. It also utilizes cards that disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard, while also able to control the board with removal spells. The deck has a consistent mana base to support its aggressive strategy and uses the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional value. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on controlling the board with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt while utilizing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes card advantage engines like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to maintain momentum. Blood Moon can disrupt opposing mana bases, while Otawara, Soaring City provides additional utility. The goal is to apply pressure early and consistently while disrupting the opponent's strategy, leading to a quick and decisive victory.

This Merfolk deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident. By using cards like Aether Vial and Mutavault, the deck can easily summon multiple creatures each turn. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Merfolk Trickster and Mistcaller helps control the opponent's board while Tide Shaper and Vodalian Hexcatcher provide additional support. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early and maintain pressure throughout the game, ultimately overpowering the opponent with its relentless aggression.
